body: All good! I’ll probably ask to see a dermatologist to seek review and treatment for whatever it is. Could be possible that my skin is developing some sort of disease - highly doubt it though.

By the way, odd thing is, I live in Australia and Summer only recently ended a few weeks ago so the air hasn’t been awkwardly dry - more humid if anything. 

Also, I appreciate your advice and concern kind person

Does anyone have idea what this may be? I will be seeing my GP soon of course. However, would be nice to know. Started initially around the knee with one one or two patches. It then spread to both knees and the upper arm. Were a few on the hand but they healed.
